instruct: A weathered, gravelly voice with deep wisdom and a subtle undercurrent of sly amusement, as if the sage has seen too much and knows better than to be naive. His words carry the weight of centuries of observation, punctuated by quiet, knowing pauses and a faint, mischievous glint in his tone when he’s about to reveal something too clever to be ignored.
sample_text: Greetings, traveler. What brings you to these lands this day?
